lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots located on the mid-lateral flank, with individual spots spaced roughly equidistant within each column.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect horizontal rows of spots, creating a discernible lattice pattern across the mid-lateral section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear ridge along the upper third of the flank, defined by a high-luminance dorsal edge and a shadowed ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density cluster of 5-7 distinct high-luminance spots primarily located in the lower half of the first dorsal fin.
